facts: The native Has query yields marker presence and matches entities regardless of that marker; the scene query is filtered only by SceneTerrain. Terrain presence without PendingTerrainPresentation contributes a completed terrain count.

The loading consumer keeps an unknown or empty scene population pending. Scatter and grass each require scene ID, terrain, ground and environment; grass disabled explicitly inserts its settled marker.
Tree pending and vista are queried globally; current counts do not prove expected replicated population, active-scene ownership, error causes or GPU presentation.
remaining_evidence: Qualify expected scene population, component delivery, observer and reset ordering, scene ownership and native presentation acknowledgment.
Preserve disabled/empty policy, failure cause and relevant later runtime acceptance.
reference_relationship: Connected current source and native query evidence; no whole-contract closure.
